result.instructions: Tools for Firmao, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which open tasks are overdue in our projects?"; "Find all customers whose name contains 'Kompserwis' and show their contact persons."; "Add a sales note to customer 51 saying we called about the renewal.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Firmao data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run firmao_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run firmao_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run firmao_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. firmao_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: firmao_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers (counterparties) with name, label, NIP, addresses, contacts and customer groups. Supports paging, sorting and filters. Firmao API: GET /svc/v1/customers.

limit.description: Results per page, 1 to 100 (default 25). Your plan may cap it lower.

sort.description: Field to sort by, e.g. name or creationDate.

filters.description: Filters as field(op) keys, e.g. {"name(contains)": "proj"} or {"id(eq)": "15"}. Ops: contains, notContains, eq, ne, in, notin (values separated by '; '), gt, ngt, ge, nge, lt, nlt, le, nle.

tools.name: firmao_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: Create a customer (counterparty) in Firmao. Creates a new record in the customer's CRM. Firmao API: POST /svc/v1/customers.

tools.name: firmao_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Create a project in Firmao with optional team members and managers. Creates a new record. Firmao API: POST /svc/v1/projects.

teamMemberIds.description: Firmao user ids to add as team members.

managerIds.description: Firmao user ids to add as managers.

tools.name: firmao_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a task in Firmao, optionally inside a project and with responsible users. Creates a new record. Firmao API: POST /svc/v1/tasks.

projectId.description: Id of the project the task belongs to. Firmao rejects an unknown id.

responsibleUserIds.description: Firmao user ids responsible for the task.

status.description: Status value as Firmao shows it, e.g. WAITING.

tools.name: firmao_create_sales_note
tools.title: Create sales note
tools.description: Add a sales note (contact history entry) to a customer in Firmao. Creates a new record. Firmao API: POST /svc/v1/salesnotes.

customerId.description: Id of the customer the note belongs to.

date.description: Note date, ISO 8601 (default: now in Firmao).
